title: Braise Satan
description:
Unfortunately, you are in Hell

You find yourself in a land full of lava, fire, and vegetables?

You have been selected for the opportunity to serve the devil himself, and perhaps earn your freedom from damnation.

Follow the recipe!

Thanks to those countless fools who came before you, Satan's tastes are refined and demanding. Do not disappoint. Your task will be easy... as long as you follow the recipe. Read the instructions or face his wrath and hunger.

The pantry comes magically stocked with everything you will need.

Prepare your dish!

Chop, fry, and plate your ingredients in the kitchen!

Defend your ingredients!

Mischievous imps will do their best to get in your way. Stop them from stealing your ingredients (and maybe throw them in the lava while you're at it).

Finish before the time runs out!As you cook the lava will rise; submit everything before the time runs out! 

If Satan's appetite isn't satisfied, who knows what he'll do!
description_short: BRAISE SATAN is a frantic cooking game set in Hell. Chop, fry, and blend your way to heaven, while fighting off the mischievous imps.
